properties-for-sale-in-costa-blanca.title: Property for sale on the Costa Blanca: all areas

properties-for-sale-in-costa-blanca.h1: Property for sale on the Costa Blanca
properties-for-sale-in-costa-blanca.lead: More than 200 km of coast in the province of Alicante, from the green coves of Jávea in the north to the long sandy beaches of Torrevieja and Orihuela Costa in the south. Here are all the homes we sell on the Costa Blanca today.
properties-for-sale-in-costa-blanca.guide_title: North and south: two sides of one coast
guide: The northern Costa Blanca, from Dénia and Jávea down to Altea and Benidorm, is greener and hillier, with rocky coves, mountains close to the sea and many villas with sea views. Prices are higher here, especially in Jávea, Moraira, Cumbre del Sol and Altea.

The southern Costa Blanca, from Alicante and Santa Pola to Torrevieja, Orihuela Costa and Pilar de la Horadada, is flatter and sunnier, with long sandy beaches, salt lakes and several golf resorts. This is where you find most new apartments and bungalows at more modest prices.
Alicante-Elche airport sits in the middle, so most towns are 20 to 60 minutes by car from the terminal, with direct flights to most European cities all year.
faq: Where is the best place to buy on the Costa Blanca?

It depends on how you will use the home. For sea views, coves and a quieter, greener coast, look at the north: Jávea, Moraira, Cumbre del Sol, Altea and Calpe. For long sandy beaches, golf and lower prices, look at the south: Torrevieja, Orihuela Costa and Guardamar. Alicante city suits buyers who want to live all year in a real city.
How much does a property cost on the Costa Blanca?

Our homes on the Costa Blanca start at {from} today. Most new apartments with 2 or 3 bedrooms in the south cost between €250,000 and €400,000, while most sea-view villas in the north cost between €1.4 and €2.5 million.
What taxes do I pay when I buy on the Costa Blanca?

On a new build you pay 10% VAT (IVA) and 1.4% stamp duty (AJD). On a resale home you pay transfer tax (ITP) of 9%, or 11% above €1 million. Add about 1.5 to 2.5% for the notary, land registry and lawyer.
Which airport is closest?
Alicante-Elche airport. Most Costa Blanca towns are 20 to 60 minutes away by car. For the far north, Valencia airport is also an option.

areas.title: North Costa Blanca
areas.text: Green hills, rocky coves and villas with sea views, from Dénia and Jávea to Altea and Benidorm.

areas.title: South Costa Blanca
areas.text: Long sandy beaches, salt lakes and golf resorts, with most of the new apartments and bungalows.

properties-for-sale-in-costa-del-sol.title: Property for sale on the Costa del Sol: all areas
properties-for-sale-in-costa-del-sol.description: {count} homes for sale on the Costa del Sol from {from}, in Marbella, Estepona, Mijas, Fuengirola, Casares and Benahavís. Town guides and buying costs.
properties-for-sale-in-costa-del-sol.h1: Property for sale on the Costa del Sol
properties-for-sale-in-costa-del-sol.lead: The coast of Málaga province, from Málaga city to Estepona and Manilva, with the mountains behind it, dozens of golf courses and a lively international community. Here are all the homes we sell on the Costa del Sol today.
properties-for-sale-in-costa-del-sol.guide_title: Life on the Costa del Sol
guide: Marbella and its neighbours Benahavís and Nueva Andalucía are the luxury heart of the coast, with Puerto Banús, the Golden Mile and the Golf Valley. Prices here are the highest in southern Spain.

To the west, Estepona, Casares and Manilva offer newer developments, a calmer pace and better value, many with sea and golf views. To the east, Mijas, Fuengirola and Benalmádena are close to Málaga and its airport, with a busy town life all year.
Málaga airport has direct flights to most European cities all year, and the AP-7 and A-7 roads connect the whole coast.
faq: Where is the best place to buy on the Costa del Sol?

For luxury and prestige, Marbella, Benahavís and Nueva Andalucía. For newer homes and better value with sea views, Estepona and Casares. For easy access to Málaga and the airport, Mijas, Fuengirola and Benalmádena.
How much does a property cost on the Costa del Sol?

Our homes on the Costa del Sol start at {from} today. Most new apartments in Estepona, Mijas and Casares cost between €400,000 and €650,000, while most villas in Marbella and Benahavís cost between €3.4 and €8 million.
What taxes do I pay when I buy on the Costa del Sol?
On a new build you pay 10% VAT (IVA) and 1.2% stamp duty (AJD). On a resale home you pay 7% transfer tax (ITP). Add about 1.5 to 2.5% for the notary, land registry and lawyer.
Which airport is closest?
Málaga airport. Fuengirola and Mijas are about 20 to 30 minutes away, Marbella about 40 minutes and Estepona about an hour. Gibraltar airport is also close to Manilva and Sotogrande.

properties-for-sale-in-costa-calida.title: Property for sale on the Costa Cálida, Murcia
properties-for-sale-in-costa-calida.description: {count} homes for sale on the Costa Cálida from {from}, around the Mar Menor in Los Alcázares, San Pedro del Pinatar and Torre-Pacheco. Guides and costs.
properties-for-sale-in-costa-calida.h1: Property for sale on the Costa Cálida
properties-for-sale-in-costa-calida.lead: The coast of the Region of Murcia, around the warm, shallow Mar Menor lagoon and its golf resorts. Here are all the homes we sell on the Costa Cálida today.
properties-for-sale-in-costa-calida.guide_title: Why buyers choose the Costa Cálida
guide: The Mar Menor is a large salt-water lagoon separated from the Mediterranean by the strip of La Manga. Its water is calm and shallow, which makes it popular with families and for water sports, and towns such as Los Alcázares, San Pedro del Pinatar and Lo Pagán line its shore.
Inland, resorts such as Santa Rosalía, La Serena Golf and Roda offer new homes with communal pools and golf at prices that are often lower than on the Costa Blanca.
The Region of Murcia airport at Corvera is the closest, and Alicante-Elche airport is about an hour away by car.
faq: Is the Costa Cálida cheaper than the Costa Blanca?
Often, yes. Our homes on the Costa Cálida start at {from} today, and new apartments and villas near the Mar Menor and its golf resorts usually cost less than similar homes on the Costa Blanca.
What taxes do I pay when I buy in Murcia?
On a new build you pay 10% VAT (IVA) and 1.5% stamp duty (AJD). On a resale home you pay 7.75% transfer tax (ITP). Add about 1.5 to 2.5% for the notary, land registry and lawyer.
Which airport is closest?
The Region of Murcia airport at Corvera, about 30 to 40 minutes from the Mar Menor. Alicante-Elche airport is about an hour away and has more flights.

luxury-villas-for-sale-in-spain.intro: On the Costa del Sol, most of our luxury villas are in Marbella, Benahavís, Estepona and Casares. On the Costa Blanca, they are in Jávea, Moraira, Cumbre del Sol, Altea and Calpe, where the coast is greener and the views are wide.
faq: What does a luxury villa cost in Spain?
Our luxury villas start at {from}. On the Costa Blanca, most sea-view villas cost between €1.4 and €2.5 million. In Marbella and Benahavís, most villas cost between €3.4 and €8 million.
What taxes do I pay on a new luxury villa?

10% VAT (IVA) plus stamp duty (AJD) of 1.4% in the Valencian Community or 1.2% in Andalusia. On a resale villa you pay transfer tax instead: 11% above €1 million in the Valencian Community and 7% in Andalusia.

sea-view-apartments-for-sale-spain.lead: Apartments and penthouses with a view of the Mediterranean, from Calpe and Benidorm to Estepona and Mijas.
sea-view-apartments-for-sale-spain.intro_title: What counts as a sea view
sea-view-apartments-for-sale-spain.intro: We list a home here when its details or title in our system say it has sea views. Some see the sea from the whole terrace, others only from one corner, so always ask us for photos taken from the terrace, or a video call.
faq: Is a sea view apartment worth the extra cost?
For many buyers, yes: sea views are the feature that sells and rents most easily on the coast. Check where the view comes from, whether a new building could block it, and how high the floor is.
